resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy - Sale (Housing Inspector's Certificate of Occupancy inspection)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Estell Manor Housing Inspector

fees.label: Certificate of Occupancy inspection (sale or rental)
fees.quote: Inspection Fee: $50.00, Payable to the "City of Estell Manor"

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the City's Certificate of Occupancy Application, tick 'Certificate of Occupancy - Sale', list the settlement date and a contact person to set up the appointment, and submit it to the Housing Inspector at 148 Cumberland Avenue, Estell Manor, NJ 08319 with the $50.00 fee payable to the City of Estell Manor. The smoke/CO certificate is a separate application through the NJ DCA portal.
resale_co.contact_title: Housing Inspector (also Zoning Officer and Code Enforcement)

resale_co.notes: The City's Certificate of Occupancy Application (scanned 8/26/2025) offers a 'Certificate of Occupancy - Sale' with a $50.00 inspection fee, and its second page says the state smoke/CO certificate for a title transfer is 'in addition to the Housing Inspector's Certificates of Occupancy inspection'. The form does not list what is inspected, a lead time or how long the certificate is valid. The City code (ecode360 ES0890) could not be opened to confirm the ordinance wording. The same form covers rentals (Certificate of Occupancy - Rental), and the City also has a rental registration form.

requirements: Secondary power source identification label for homes with solar, generators or batteries (the State application is now the CSACMASPSIL)
The City's CO form (August 2025) still describes the state certificate as covering a fire extinguisher

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee

fees.label: More than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: If you are applying for a certificate more than ten business days from the closing date the fee is $45 dollars

fees.label: 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: if applying 4 to 10 business days from the closing date the fee is $90

fees.label: Less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: if the closing date is less than four business days the fee is $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal (Apply Smoke Certification). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The City's instructions: complete the Smoke Cert data, submit, pay, and wait for the status 'Approved-Pending Inspection'. For help email BFCECodeAdmin@dca.nj.gov or call 609-633-6132.
authorities.contact_title: Bureau Chief, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (listed as the Fire Official for Estell Manor in the state fire directory)

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Estell Manor as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The City's own CO application tells sellers to get the fire safety certificate through the State system. The City's form (2025) names the certificate with a fire extinguisher; the current State application title (CSACMASPSIL) reflects P.L.2025, c.19, which replaced the extinguisher with a secondary power source label. The directory lists (609) 633-6132; the Bureau's page lists (609) 633-6106 for Louis Kilmer.

open_questions: What the City's sale CO inspection covers, how far ahead to apply and how long the certificate is valid are not stated on the form; confirm with the Housing Inspector at (609) 476-2692 ext. 104.
